chapter_title: Concerning the Advent of Five Fathers from the Five Limbs of the Father
chapter_note: Very short, remarkably clean chapter. The oldest teaching layer dominates — a compact five-fold emanation-to-faculty mapping (P2) plus a process summary (P3), wrapped in a thin dialogue frame (P1). No editorial bridge, no institutional content, no exhortation. The substrate shift score (+17.19 in second half) reflects the teaching content concentrated in P2-P3. The five emanation figures (Ambassador, Beloved of the Lights, Mother of Life, Jesus the Beloved, Virgin of Light) are mapped to the Father's five limbs (mind, thought, insight, counsel, consideration) — a classic Persian-tradition correspondential enumeration.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Standard formulaic opening: 'Once again the apostle speaks concerning... [He] speaks thus:' The topic label ('the advent of five fathers from the Father, one after another') is embedded within the frame attribution and is fully restated in P2-P3, contributing no unique substrate content.

paragraphs.core_text: The [Ambas]sador [came] from his mind; the Beloved of the Lights [from his thought]; the Mother of Life from his insight; [Jesus] the Beloved from his counsel; the Virgin of Lig[ht f]rom his consideration.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Pure five-fold emanation-faculty mapping. Both sides internal to the cosmic system: cosmic emanation → faculty/limb of the Father. The systematic structure (five beings mapped to five intellectual faculties) is characteristic of the oldest correspondential teaching. 'Jesus the Beloved' here is a cosmic emanation figure within the Manichaean system, not the historical Jesus — the name may represent a later overlay on an older cosmic figure, but the mapping structure itself is clearly substrate.

paragraphs.core_text: So in this way were summone[d these five] fathers. These five advents came from the five limbs [of the Father]. One came from another and was manifested in its season.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Emanation process description — summarizes the sequential structure of the five evocations. 'One came from another and was manifested in its season' describes the temporal ordering of emanations within the cosmic system. Both sides remain internal. The summarizing formula 'So in this way' is mild but the content is entirely cosmological process.
